question: YAGK is related to PRXB in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, OQWA is related to FHNR. To which of the following options is NPVZ related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**YAGK : PRXB**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac2b651ef9925fcc0fd759e96db27ac17bf69611c68617f7c4ef9ef4d548283f.png] 

**OQWA : FHNR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/874c47618fc91a4f63a217c2f3638b4c0eeedbad22276b5f84ae786ba6fb852e.png] 

 

**Applying the logic to NPVZ:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b123928346ced3bbe640234ad57cb3e8f6b60797783b24484e5370718c1c045.png] 

Thus, NPVZ is related to **EGMQ**.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4"**.
